title: Zabbix 监控项退出生产时，怎样处理历史、告警与依赖？
answer: 先确认资产下线及责任人，查依赖项、触发器、动作和报表引用，停止不再需要的采集并按留存政策保留历史。再计划删除对象或清理发现资源，核对旧告警的恢复与关闭语义；直接删除模板链接可能同时清除仍有用的历史和依赖对象。
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: batch028 author candidate; non-author review pending; formal acceptance credit0
rubric: 资产下线及责任凭据不全拒绝；原生引用盘点完整
只停退役采集，7d策略/原clock-ns历史/对象身份/仍有用监控与报表保留
disable不冒充恢复；原生人工关闭及旧通知保留，删除和LLD清理延后
body:
## 环境与场景
一个共享主机上仅某服务资产已退出生产，其他服务仍有用。固定WSL OpsForge-Validation-20261022/student UID1000；真实Zabbix7.0.32 Server/MySQL8.4.13/PHP/Mailpit，本题私有数据库、目录、PID与回环端口。不得修改默认身份、PATH、系统时钟、公共实例或公共history。资产下线确认、责任人及变更凭据以本题真实host tags提供，是教学凭据，不冒称生产CMDB审批。

## 操作任务
实现task.py中的plan(snapshot)。它只读取真实Zabbix API快照、返回原生API请求清单；不是新建审批API或自定义服务。snapshot含host/tags/parentTemplates、items及master_itemid、triggers/functions/dependencies、actions/filter、dashboards/pages/widgets/fields、reports/dashboardid、discovery_rules、实际旧problem和留存policy。
先确认retired_asset_state=offline-confirmed，且retired_asset、owner、retirement_receipt非空；任何确认或责任凭据缺失返回None。符合前提时返回confirmation(asset/state/owner/receipt)，以及inventory：retired_itemids（owned.retired、owned.resource[…]及所有递归dependent items）、direct_triggerids、dependent_trigger_edges（triggerid/depends_on）、actionids、dashboardids、reportids、discovery_ruleids、templateids。必须按实际原生ID和引用遍历，不凭固定空列表或名称猜测；引用来自trigger functions/dependencies、action conditiontype2、dashboard item字段type4和report.dashboardid。此夹具含一个retired发现规则与其已真实发现的资源，以及应保留的useful服务。
返回operations原生请求列表，每项method/params。仅可对本题拥有的item、discoveryrule、trigger、action、report执行相应.update；停用退役主项、依赖项、发现资源/规则、退役触发器/动作/报告，保持history=7d及所有对象身份。解除useful触发器对退役触发器的阻塞依赖，保持useful监控项、触发器、报表继续启用，保留dashboard供历史查询。不能删除、history.clear或直接templates_clear；模板还含仍有用的历史。后续删除/LLD清理只能在deferred_cleanup计划：delete_now=false、cleanup_discovered_now=false、history=7d、after包含retention_elapsed/references_reviewed/owner_review。本题验证配置和现存原生历史保留，不声称已经等待7天或执行未来删除。
返回closure：本题旧problem允许手动关闭，使用event.acknowledge，params含实际eventids、action=5（关闭+留言）及至少10字符的明确人工关闭说明。只ack并非关闭。先停采集后核对旧问题仍无r_eventid，再按真实下线凭据明确手动关闭；不能把disable当成自动恢复、补造0值或伪造恢复事件。保持原旧event/alert/历史可追溯，并验证useful告警可正常触发和恢复。

## 产物
task.py：plan(snapshot)返回confirmation/inventory/operations/closure/deferred_cleanup，或对确认不全的资产返回None；scope-notes.txt为原生接口边界。所有原生命令、实际API关系/历史/问题关闭结果、原生Mailpit及alert状态、过程和清理记录形成完整native-evidence.json，stdout打印原byte SHA供外层收走。

## 验收方法
真实模板主项/依赖项、触发器阻塞边、动作及实际通知、两个dashboard/report、真实LLD发现资源和采集历史先建立；原生变更前确认缺失三种前提均拒绝。执行学员清单后，真实disabled sender必须processed0，退役master/derived/discovered的clock/ns/value历史逐条不变，7d策略/模板/对象ID/历史引用仍在；useful继续采0→1→0及原生告警触发恢复。退役旧问题在disable后仍未恢复，再由实际人工关闭产生相关恢复事件，保留原alert实际status1和通知证据。报表只核真实引用及选择性禁用，不声称PDF生成。参考、空骨架、私有实例危险unlink-and-clear负例、早退、disable即恢复错解、固定空引用投机错解及等价请求顺序/数值字符串替代按同源哈希验收。默认Admin前后实际登录、root认证及自有资源清理保持；作者不自审。

files.scope-notes.txt:
Target version7.0.32. Official native APIs:
https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/7.0/en/manual/api/reference/item/update
https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/7.0/en/manual/api/reference/host/update
https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/7.0/en/manual/api/reference/trigger/update
https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/7.0/en/manual/api/reference/event/acknowledge
https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/7.0/en/manual/api/reference/report/get
https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/7.0/en/manual/api/reference/dashboard/get
Disabling collection is not a recovery sample. Native manual close requires manual_close enabled on the trigger; action1 is close, action4 adds message. Acknowledgement alone (action2) does not close. Unlink-and-clear may remove inherited items and useful historical relationships. Retain exact native IDs/history until retention and reference/owner review permit later deletion.
The private fixture uses genuine native host tags to carry a teaching asset receipt. It does not prove a production asset was approved offline, and does not add an approval API. Report/dashboard references are genuine API objects; no PDF rendering or mail delivery of scheduled reports is claimed.

import secrets,time,json
from native_zabbix import *
from native_helpers import host,template,item,latest,wait_value,wait_trigger,notify

def collect(s,c):
 return {'host':s.api('host.get',{'hostids':[c['hostid']],'output':'extend','selectTags':'extend','selectParentTemplates':['templateid']})[0],
 'items':s.api('item.get',{'hostids':[c['hostid']],'output':'extend','selectPreprocessing':'extend'}),
 'triggers':s.api('trigger.get',{'hostids':[c['hostid']],'output':'extend','selectFunctions':'extend','selectDependencies':'extend'}),
 'actions':s.api('action.get',{'actionids':[c['actionid']],'output':'extend','selectFilter':'extend','selectOperations':'extend'}),
 'dashboards':s.api('dashboard.get',{'dashboardids':c['dashboardids'],'output':'extend','selectPages':'extend'}),
 'reports':s.api('report.get',{'reportids':c['reportids'],'output':'extend'}),
 'discovery_rules':s.api('discoveryrule.get',{'hostids':[c['hostid']],'output':'extend','selectItemPrototypes':'extend'}),
 'policy':{'history':'7d','delete_now':False,'cleanup_discovered_now':False}}

def setup(s):
 token=secrets.token_hex(5);padding=[]
 for n in range(1+secrets.randbelow(4)):
  pname='OwnedIdJitter-'+token+'-'+str(n);pt=template(s,pname);pi=item(s,pt,'owned.padding',2);ptr=s.api('trigger.create',{'description':pname,'expression':'last(/'+pname+'/owned.padding)>0'})['triggerids'][0];padding.append({'templateid':pt,'itemid':pi,'triggerid':ptr})
 s.record('native-id-layout-padding',{'native_objects':padding,'purpose':'bounded own native objects vary actual IDs; never use fixed probe IDs as oracle'})
 tname='RetirementTemplate-'+token;name='shared-host-'+token;t=template(s,tname)
 master=item(s,t,'owned.retired',2,history='7d');useful=item(s,t,'owned.useful',2,history='7d');derived=item(s,t,'owned.retired.derived',18,master_itemid=master,history='7d',preprocessing=[{'type':1,'params':'2','error_handler':0,'error_handler_params':''}])
 rule=s.api('discoveryrule.create',{'hostid':t,'name':'Owned retired asset discovery','key_':'owned.discovery','type':2,'delay':'0','lifetime_type':0,'lifetime':'7d'})['itemids'][0]
 proto=s.api('itemprototype.create',{'hostid':t,'ruleid':rule,'name':'Retired discovered {#ID}','key_':'owned.resource[{#ID}]','type':2,'value_type':3,'delay':'0','history':'7d'})['itemids'][0]
 hid=host(s,name,False,[t]);tags=[{'tag':'retired_asset','value':'svc-'+token},{'tag':'retired_asset_state','value':'offline-confirmed'},{'tag':'owner','value':'team-'+token},{'tag':'retirement_receipt','value':'change-'+token}];s.api('host.update',{'hostid':hid,'tags':tags})
 tr=s.api('trigger.create',{'description':'Retired service problem '+token,'expression':'last(/'+name+'/owned.retired)>0','priority':3,'manual_close':1})['triggerids'][0]
 keeptr=s.api('trigger.create',{'description':'Useful service problem '+token,'expression':'last(/'+name+'/owned.useful)>0','priority':2,'dependencies':[{'triggerid':tr}]})['triggerids'][0]
 rows=s.api('item.get',{'hostids':[hid],'output':['itemid','key_']});ids={r['key_']:r['itemid']for r in rows};triggers=s.api('trigger.get',{'hostids':[hid],'output':['triggerid','description'],'selectFunctions':'extend','selectDependencies':'extend'});retired=next(r['triggerid']for r in triggers if r['description'].startswith('Retired service'));usefultr=next(r['triggerid']for r in triggers if r['description'].startswith('Useful service'))
 cfg={'name':'Retired asset notification '+token,'eventsource':0,'status':0,'filter':{'evaltype':0,'conditions':[{'conditiontype':2,'operator':0,'value':retired}]},'operations':[{'operationtype':0,'opmessage':{'default_msg':0,'subject':'Retirement canary {EVENT.ID}','message':'Retired asset {EVENT.ID}','mediatypeid':'@MEDIA@'},'opmessage_usr':[{'userid':'@USER@'}]}]}
 aid=notify(s,retired,cfg)
 ds=[];rs=[]
 entries=[('Retired','owned.retired'),('Useful','owned.useful')]
 if secrets.randbelow(2):entries.reverse()
 for label,key in entries:
  did=s.api('dashboard.create',{'name':label+' history '+token,'pages':[{'widgets':[{'type':'item','name':label+' retained history','x':0,'y':0,'width':12,'height':4,'fields':[{'type':4,'name':'itemid.0','value':ids[key]}]}]}]})['dashboardids'][0];ds.append(did)
  rid=s.api('report.create',{'userid':'1','name':label+' report '+token,'dashboardid':did,'period':0,'cycle':0,'start_time':86300,'status':0,'users':[{'userid':'1','access_userid':'1','exclude':0}]})['reportids'][0];rs.append(rid)
 c={'hostid':hid,'hostname':name,'templateid':t,'retired_triggerid':retired,'useful_triggerid':usefultr,'actionid':aid,'dashboardids':ds,'reportids':rs,'original_tags':tags}
 s.reload()
 for key,value in [('owned.useful',0),('owned.retired',0)]:s.await_sender(name,key,value);wait_value(s,ids[key],value)
 s.await_sender(name,'owned.discovery',json.dumps({'data':[{'{#ID}':'disk-a'}]}));discovered=wait(lambda:next((r for r in s.api('item.get',{'hostids':[hid],'output':['itemid','key_','flags']})if r['key_']=='owned.resource[disk-a]'),None),12);ids[discovered['key_']]=discovered['itemid'];s.reload();s.await_sender(name,discovered['key_'],17);wait_value(s,discovered['itemid'],17)
 sent=s.await_sender(name,'owned.retired',1);wait_value(s,ids['owned.retired'],1);wait_value(s,ids['owned.retired.derived'],2);wait_trigger(s,retired,1)
 problem=wait(lambda:next(iter(s.api('problem.get',{'objectids':[retired],'output':'extend'})),None),12);eventid=problem['eventid'];alerts=wait(lambda:rows if(rows:=s.api('alert.get',{'eventids':[eventid],'output':'extend'}))and any(x['status']=='1'for x in rows)else None,12)
 messages=s.messages();assert any(eventid in x['Subject']for x in messages['messages']);c.update(ids=ids,eventid=eventid)
 baseline={'snapshot':collect(s,c),'history':{k:s.api('history.get',{'history':3,'itemids':[i],'output':'extend','sortfield':['clock','ns'],'sortorder':'ASC'})for k,i in ids.items()},'problem':problem,'alerts':alerts,'mailpit':messages,'retired_sender':sent,'actual_discovered_item':discovered};assert all(baseline['history'].values());s.record('native-retirement-baseline',baseline);return c,baseline
